name: investment-toolkit-plugins
description: Investment Toolkit plugins: AI stock valuation, portfolio advisor (health, rebalancing, strategy review), and suite orchestration.

plugins.name: stock-valuation
plugins.description: AI-driven autonomous stock valuation and research engine. Skills: /evaluate-stock (Bear/Base/Bull DCF projections with analyticsLog), /research-stock (qualitative sweep with Class A/B/C/D change classification and decision gate before re-valuation).

plugins.name: toolkit-manager
plugins.description: Orchestrator for the Investment Screener suite. Handles server startup (/start-screener) and Questrade API token seeding (/setup-questrade).

plugins.name: etf-analysis
plugins.description: AI-driven ETF and fund analysis engine. Three fund types: CLOSED_END, THEMATIC_ETF, CASH_FUND. Trigger: /analyze-etf {TICKER}.

plugins.name: tradingview
plugins.description: TradingView Desktop integration for real-time prices, DCF alerts, chart snapshots, portfolio sync, live order execution, and automated Pine Script technical analysis. Skills: /tv-price-refresh, /tv-alert-sync, /tv-snapshot, /tv-ta, /tv-portfolio-sync, /place-order, /modify-order, /cancel-order, /get-orders, /pine-inject, /tv-ta-deep. Requires TV Desktop running with --remote-debugging-port=9222.
